## Research

Game theory; modelling, value, and strategic use of information; bounded rationality and complexity; finance and insurance.

[Working papers and publications](papers/index.qmd)

[SInfoNiA](sinfonia/index.qmd) — awarded an ERC Advanced Grant in 2024; funded by UKRI.

## Teaching resources

[*Théorie de la décision et théorie des jeux*](teaching-material/theorie-decision-jeux.qmd) — notes de cours en français.

[Advanced microeconomics: game theory](teaching-material/index.qmd#advanced-game-theory) — graduate lecture notes in English.

[*Introduction aux sciences économiques*](papers/index.qmd#book-section) — textbook with Jean-Baptiste Michau and Vincent Rollet, Economica, 2024.
